{{Quote|MI-726 was assigned to a board member of Sienar Fleet Systems.|A bounty posting on MI-726 mentions the board member|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
An '''individual''' worked as a board member of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] design company known as [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was assigned [[MI-726]], a [[MI-series security droid]], to guard his home, however the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] went rogue and abandoned the board member during an [[Attack on a Sienar Fleet Systems board member's home|attack]] on his property by a group of rebel [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]. The rebels were hoping to find schematics for prototype [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|vessels]] in the board member's home to find the ship's weaknesses for use in the future.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The board member was mentioned in the "[[Bounties to Die For]]" article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series,<ref name="BTDF" /> which was published [[September 4]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010815.html|text=Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6}}</ref> The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and the article was written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]].<ref name="BTDF" />
